title: PRO Building Systems
description: probldgsystems.com P.R.O. Building Systems Inc is an American design build general contractor founded in 1969 in Atlanta by Paul Ray Orton Sr. Led by president and COO Edward Mock Jr and executive VP, licensed architect Steven Ellis, it has 50 plus years of commercial construction experience and a leadership team of 150 plus years. Car dealerships are its specialty, 50 to 60 percent of work, with landmark builds for Porsche, Jaguar Land Rover, Lexus, Genesis, Kia and Hennessy Ford Lincoln, plus offices, restaurants, warehouses and government buildings. Licensed in six southeastern states, it delivers turnkey design build projects in six to eight months with 99 percent repeat clients and referrals. The team includes in house architects, pre construction and construction management plus 25 superintendents with 100 years combined field experience. In 2024 it ranked 16th among Atlanta's 100 fastest growing private companies.
